
 Usage: agentos environments [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

 Your agents' cloud computers: list, show, close, allow, set up, connect
 repositories.

╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --home        <path>  AGENTOS_HOME (default: $AGENTOS_HOME)                  │
│ --help                Show this message and exit.                            │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Commands ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ list   Environments of this node: state, title, repository, machine, cost so │
│        far, time left.                                                       │
│ show   One environment: its machine, lanes, the calls its agent made, and    │
│        its unsaved work.                                                     │
│ close  Close an environment; refused while its work is not pushed, unless    │
│        --discard.                                                            │
│ allow  Set the limits that bound the environments agents open.               │
│ setup  Check what environments need on this node, and say what is missing.   │
│ repo   Connect private repositories: a key or token in the vault, and the    │
│        declaration for env.                                                  │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
